raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Capital Markets Operations Analyst with a PGDM in Finance and experience in Fixed Income Middle Office. Skilled in Credit Default Swaps (CDS) broker reconciliation, Trade Support, Securities maintenance, Operational controls, Root cause analysis, exception management, and management reporting. Partnered with Technology teams to translate business requirements into Xceptor-based automation enhancements, reducing reconciliation effort by approximately 50%. Recognized for process improvement, operational governance, and process standardization, with NISM Series VII – Securities Operations & Risk Management (SORM) certification.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Capital Markets & Operations: Fixed Income Operations, Trade Lifecycle, Post-Trade Operations, Credit Default Swaps (CDS), Broker Reconciliation, Securities Maintenance, Extended Settlements, Re-Rates, Securitization Reporting.
Risk, Controls & Governance: Operational Controls, Exception Management, Maker-Checker Controls, Process Governance, SOP Development, FMEA Documentation, Risk Mitigation.
Process Improvement & Analysis: Business Process Improvement, Requirements Analysis, Data Validation, Automation Testing & Validation, Root Cause Analysis, Stakeholder Management.
Systems & Tools: Xceptor, TPS Blotter, FINWS, Bloomberg Terminal, MarketWire, Oasys, Citihawk Olympus, Microsoft Excel (Advanced), SharePoint.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Analyst, Fixed Income Middle Office — eClerx Services Ltd. Mumbai, India • Execute Fixed Income Middle Office post-trade operations across Extended Settlements, CDS Broker Reconciliation, Re-Rates,
May 2025 – Present
Management Reporting, and Securitization Reporting for North America (NAM) markets.
Reconcile 2,500+ monthly CDS trades against broker confirmations, investigating exceptions, identifying root causes of breaks, and driving resolution with Front Office, Back Office, and brokers to ensure trade integrity and adherence to control frameworks.
Execute maker-checker controls across 20+ operational activities/MIS reports, ensuring data integrity, reporting accuracy, and adherence to governance standards.
Process interest rate amendments and securities reference-data maintenance across multiple Tier-1 global bank client portfolios in FINWS.
Reconcile cash transaction and balance statements, payment/collection memos, and income trackers supporting securitization reporting across multiple accounts.
Validated and maintained client Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), performing data-quality checks on settlement account details before downstream processing.
Prepare the Monthly Business Review (MBR) for NAM, consolidating operational data — including EMEA regional inputs — across 7,000+ monthly transactions.
Managed and maintained client and entity reference data, validating mandatory attributes and ensuring accurate, complete and consistent information across operational systems
Manage DTC, LOFF, and QIB documentation workflows with counterparties and internal teams, driving timely resolution and settlement readiness.
Supported creation and maintenance of client trading accounts by validating account information, settlement attributes and supporting documentation before downstream processing.
Monitored daily/monthly reconciliation reports, investigated data and transaction exceptions, and coordinated with relevant stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and maintain data accuracy.
Partner with Technology teams to validate business requirements, implement reconciliation rule enhancements, and support controlled production releases.
Coordinated with clients and global stakeholders to validate information, resolve discrepancies and ensure timely completion of time-sensitive operational deliverables.
• Authored SOPs and FMEA documentation to standardise processes and support governance and knowledge transfer.
Finance Research Intern, Corporate Alliance — Finance Forum of India • Conducted financial and sector-level research to evaluate corporate alliance and partnership opportunities. • Prepared analytical reports and presentations on financial statements, industry trends, and market data for senior stakeholders.
Jan 2024 – Jul 2024
KEY PROJECT — CDS BROKER RECONCILIATION AUTOMATION (XCEPTOR)
Led business-side enhancement of an Xceptor automation, analysing reconciliation gaps across multiple broker recap formats and defining broker-specific business rules.
Partnered with Technology to define automation requirements, provide business scenarios, and validate reconciliation logic. • Performed business validation, UAT, and production verification comparing broker recap files, TPS trade data, and automated outputs.
Reduced false reconciliation breaks and cut manual reconciliation effort by 50%, enabling faster, more reliable daily processing.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
eClerx Value Award — outstanding performance in Fixed Income Middle Office operations, recognising operational excellence, process ownership, and business continuity support across Extended Settlements, Re-Rates, Reporting, and Broker Reconciliation.
